summary: Relative ordering of the job within a route; relations outrank it, it overrides order_grouping.
businessRules: Lower sequence_order is served earlier; a hard relations constraint overrides it.

sequence_order defines: Use this parameter to prioritize completing a task relative to certain other tasks. A task configured with a sequence_order of 2 will be done after the task with sequence_order of 1, but before the…
Must stay consistent with: relations. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Relations define hard sequencing: job pairs, duration bounds, vehicle affinity.
Numeric field; verify sign (positive/negative) and unit from spec.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: two jobs sequence_order 1 and 2 served in that order.
Interaction: Interaction: with a relation set, raising visit_lateness_penalty has no effect.
Interaction: Infeasible: an in_direct_sequence relation whose ordering is impossible -> all its tasks unassigned.
